verses.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: Make for yourself two heavy silver containers. Use them as a means of carrying goods around. They will serve as tools for transporting things from one place to another.
verses.3: And they shall be fixed in those places, and all the congregation will gather at the entrance of the Tabernacle.
verses.4: And if they are stationed in one place, and the leaders of Israel come to you.
verses.5: And you set up the wheels, and they moved forward along the parked vehicles.
verses.6: And they set up the wheels a second time. Then they traveled along the parked vehicles. The wheels were fixed in place for their journey.
verses.7: And in the congregation, they shall settle down and not move around.
verses.8: And the priests, the sons of Aaron, shall be appointed to serve in those offices. They shall serve as a perpetual example for your generations.
verses.9: And when you return from war in your own land, against those evil people who have attacked you and treated you badly. Then you will be remembered by your God Jehovah, and you will be saved from your enemies.
verses.10: And on the day of your joy, and in your festivals, and at the beginning of your new year, and when you set up decorations on your altars, I will make these things a reminder for you before your God. I, Jehovah, your God.
verses.11: And in the second year, on the twelfth day of the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, the cloud rose from above the tent of God.
verses.12: And the sons of Israel went on their journey from the Mediterranean Sea. The cloud settled over the land of Paran.
verses.13: And they went forth in the first place by the hand of Moses, according to God’s will.
verses.14: And Deguel led the Jews from their camp to their camps. And over one of those camps was Nahshon, son of Aminadab.
verses.15: And over the army of Mattan’s sons was Netanel, son of Zuar.
verses.16: And over the army of the sons of Zebulun was Eliyahu son of Chelon.
verses.17: And they went up into the tent. Then, the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari carried the tent along with them.
verses.18: And he traveled from the camp of Reuben to their camps. And on Elizur son of Sedior’s camp he stood.
verses.19: And on the army of Mattan, sons of Shimeon, Shlumi’el, son of Zuriy Shaday.
verses.20: And over the army of Mattah’s sons, Eliezer son of Dauel.
verses.21: And the priests, who carried the sacred vessels, traveled to build the tabernacle before its completion.
verses.22: And Degol traveled from the camp of the Beni Ephraim to their armies. And upon his army was Elishama, son of Ammihud.
verses.23: And on the chariot were the sons of Manasseh: Gamliel, son of Pedah-Tzur.
verses.24: And over the army of Mati’s sons, Binyamin’s sons were captured.
verses.25: And they traveled from the camp of Benjamin to all the camps. They went on their way, and Ahijaz, son of Imeshdadai, led them along.
verses.26: And upon the army of Mattah’s sons, who were fallen by Paghiyael, son of Akhran.
verses.27: And over the army of Mattan’s sons, Ahir’a son of Eynan.
verses.28: These were the descendants of Israel, who went to their own tribes.
verses.29: And Moses said to Jotham, the son of Reuven, the priest: “Moses has appointed riders for us. Let us go to the place where Jehovah said that He would give it to us. Then we will be healed, just as Jehovah has spoken well about Israel.”
verses.30: And he said to him, “I will not go, but I will go to my land and to my birthplace.”
verses.31: And he said, “Please leave us alone. Otherwise, you would know where we are located, and you would be able to see us.”
verses.32: And it shall be that you will go with us. Then the good will come from Jehovah, and we will be blessed.
verses.33: And they traveled from the hill of Jehovah, for three days. And the ark of the covenant of Jehovah went before them, also for three days, to give them rest.
verses.34: And the heavens of Jehovah will rain down upon them as they depart from their camp.
verses.35: And it happened during that journey in the wilderness. Moses said, “May the LORD come and destroy your enemies, and may He take away those who hate you from before you.”
verses.36: And Nebuchadnezzar said, “May the LORD return the fortunes of thousands of Israel.”
